name: Qwen3.8 27B 0814
notes:
NON-THINKING profile, transcribed from Qwen's published values with no deviation: temperature 0.7, top_p 0.80, top_k 20, min_p 0.0, presence_penalty 1.5, repetition_penalty 1.0. Qwen's thinking profile (1.0 / 0.95 / 20 / 0.0 / 0.0 / 1.0) is the one generation_config.json carries; the control-plane playground sends it as a per-request override when the Enable Thinking opt-in is set. The non-thinking profile belongs here because Lucebox renders every request with thinking disabled by default (enable_thinking hard-coded false in server/src/server/http_server.cpp:1841, an upstream decision; only request fields raise it).

presence_penalty 1.5 WAS REMOVED AND PUT BACK on 2026-08-30 — do not remove it again without reading this. Lucebox gates speculative decoding on sampler_.needs_logit_processing() (common/sampler.h:39 — an OR over temp>0, rep_pen>1, freq_pen!=0, pres_pen!=0). Any non-zero value switches the engine into sampled-verify (qwen35_backend.cpp:2675), which turns off the DFlash 2 selector and the DSpark Markov head (:3103, :3125). An isolated A/B at ~60k context on identical prompts made presence_penalty look expensive: 38.6 tok/s at 0.0 vs 32.2 at 1.5, -17%. It does not hold up in production. Two real ds-harness coding sessions, 20 turns with the penalty and 26 without: 41.78 vs 42.07 tok/s decode, +0.7%; restricted to substantial turns (out>=200) where acceptance matched, 41.78 vs 43.24, +3.5%. Workload variance (66-71% acceptance swings between sessions) is an order of magnitude larger than the effect. A 1-3% gain does not buy a deviation from the upstream spec, and dropping the penalty gives up the repetition protection it exists for — Lucebox's own degenerate-run guard (DFLASH_DEGENERATE_RUN_TOKENS, qwen35_backend.cpp:2387) only breaks a single token repeated N times and is off by default, so it does not cover block-level loops. Note also that the sampled-verify cliff itself is paid by ANY sampling and is not attributable to this field. The real cost centre is prefill, 66% of session wall time.

max_tokens=32768 deliberately preserves the existing family:qwen35 fallback because the cited upstream sampling sources do not establish a different Lucebox combined output cap. No complex-problem budget, reasoning tiers, or thinking hint is asserted. min_p=0.0 is retained for source fidelity but the current Lucebox SamplerCfg/parse_request_sampler path does not apply min_p (presence_penalty and repetition_penalty are applied). Ollama's draft_num_predict=4 is inference-engine-specific and is deliberately omitted.
